units.source_text: 把它說成是我人生中，唯一的一次拒絕別人勸誘，都不為過。

en.t: It would not be an exaggeration to say that this was the only time in my life I ever refused someone else's urging.

units.source_text: 我的不幸就是缺乏拒絕能力者的不幸。

en.t: My misfortune was the misfortune of someone who lacked the ability to refuse.

units.source_text: 拒絕對方的勸誘時，最讓我恐懼的，是在對方和自己的心中留下一條永遠無法修復的裂痕。

en.t: When I refused another person's urging, what terrified me most was leaving an irreparable crack forever in both that person's heart and my own.

units.source_text: 可是，我當時卻很自然地拒絕了曾經瘋狂尋求和依賴的嗎啡。

en.t: And yet, at that moment, I quite naturally refused the morphine I had once sought and depended on so frantically.

units.source_text: 也許是被良子那「如神靈般無知」所打動了吧。

en.t: Perhaps I had been moved by Yoshiko's almost divine ignorance.

units.source_text: 在那一瞬間，難道不是已擺脫了上癮嗎？

en.t: In that instant, had I not already broken free of the addiction?

units.source_text: 可是，之後很快地，我被那位靦腆微笑的年輕醫師領進了某一棟病房，咔嚓一聲，門被鎖上。

en.t: But soon afterward, I was led by that young doctor with the shy smile into a certain hospital ward, and with a click the door was locked.

units.source_text: 這裡是一所精神病醫院。

en.t: I want to go somewhere there are no women.
